name: Pogo
summary: Up and down vote buttons whose score chip rides a real pogo spring and rolls its digits like an odometer
about: An answer card from a travel question board with an up and a down vote button and the score sitting on a coiled spring between them. Upvoting squashes the spring, launches the chip into the air with sparks and a +1 while the digits roll up (1,299 becomes 1,300), then it lands, squashes and bounces to rest with a ring. Downvoting shoves the chip down so the spring crushes flat, dust puffs from the base and the digits roll down; the up and down counts and the helpful bar update, and pressing a lit arrow takes your vote back.
how: Press the up arrow (or Tab to it and press Enter or Space) to upvote and watch the chip launch.
Press the down arrow to downvote: the spring crushes and the score rolls down.
Press the lit arrow again to take your vote back.
The counts under the answer and the helpful bar follow your vote.
